text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Casino Drive, who was entrusted with 
training the team members, shared an 
update report.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, please don't worry. Training has 
proceeded according to plan.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's motivation is quite high, which 
is good. I even found myself getting fired 
up.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
You'll surely feel a difference even in a 
short time. Please look forward to our 
next training session!
